sections.title: Variables
sections.description: Assignment, constants, and references that share one value.

snippets.code:
<?php
$quantity = 3;
$unitPrice = 4.5;
$currency = 'EUR';

// Variables are dynamically typed
$quantity = 'three';

// Constants cannot be reassigned
const TAX_RATE = 0.23;
define('SHOP_NAME', 'Corner Store');

echo $currency, ' ', TAX_RATE, ' ', SHOP_NAME, PHP_EOL;
var_dump($quantity);

<?php
$balance = 100;

// The ampersand makes both names point at the same value
$alias = &$balance;
$alias -= 25;
echo $balance, PHP_EOL; // 75

function deposit(int &$amount, int $cents): void
{
    $amount += $cents;
}

deposit($balance, 50);
echo $balance, PHP_EOL; // 125

sections.title: Types
sections.description: Scalars, arrays, nullable values, unions, and enums.

snippets.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

$seats = 24;              // int
$rating = 4.6;            // float
$city = 'Lisbon';         // string
$open = true;             // bool
$closedAt = null;         // null
$menu = ['soup', 'fish']; // array

var_dump($seats, $rating, $city, $open, $closedAt, $menu);

// Loose comparison converts, strict comparison does not
var_dump('24' == 24);  // true
var_dump('24' === 24); // false

<?php
enum OrderState: string
{
    case Draft = 'draft';
    case Paid = 'paid';
    case Shipped = 'shipped';
}

function describe(int|string $reference, ?OrderState $state = null): string
{
    $suffix = $state?->value ?? 'unknown';
    return "order {$reference}: {$suffix}";
}

echo describe(1042), PHP_EOL;                       // order 1042: unknown
echo describe('A-9', OrderState::Shipped), PHP_EOL; // order A-9: shipped

sections.title: Arrays
sections.description: Indexed and keyed arrays, plus the helpers used every day.

snippets.code:
<?php
$queue = ['first', 'second'];
$queue[] = 'third';            // append at the end
array_unshift($queue, 'zero'); // insert at the front

$config = [
    'host' => 'db.internal',
    'port' => 5432,
    'retry' => ['limit' => 3, 'delay' => 2],
];

echo $config['retry']['delay'], PHP_EOL; // 2
echo count($queue), PHP_EOL;             // 4
var_dump(in_array('third', $queue, true)); // true

<?php
$prices = ['pen' => 2, 'book' => 15, 'bag' => 40];

$withTax = array_map(static fn (int $p): float => $p * 1.2, $prices);
$cheap = array_filter($prices, static fn (int $p): bool => $p < 20);
ksort($withTax);

[$pen, $book] = array_values($cheap);
echo $pen, ' ', $book, PHP_EOL;   // 2 15
echo array_key_last($withTax), PHP_EOL; // pen
echo implode(',', array_keys($prices)), PHP_EOL; // pen,book,bag

sections.title: Control Flow
sections.description: Branches that return values, strict match arms, and loops.

snippets.code:
<?php
$score = 87;

if ($score >= 90) {
    $grade = 'A';
} elseif ($score >= 80) {
    $grade = 'B';
} else {
    $grade = 'C';
}

// match compares strictly and produces a value
$summary = match (true) {
    $score >= 90 => 'outstanding',
    $score >= 80 => 'solid',
    default => 'needs work',
};

echo $grade, ' ', $summary, PHP_EOL;

<?php
for ($step = 1; $step <= 3; $step++) {
    echo $step, ' ';
}

$files = ['notes.txt', 'photo.jpg'];
foreach ($files as $position => $file) {
    echo "{$position}: {$file}", PHP_EOL;
}

$attempts = 0;
while ($attempts < 2) {
    $attempts++;
}

do {
    $attempts--;
} while ($attempts > 0);

echo $attempts, PHP_EOL; // 0

<?php
$status = 'paused';

switch ($status) {
    case 'running':
        echo 'go', PHP_EOL;
        break;
    case 'paused':
        echo 'wait', PHP_EOL;
        break;
    default:
        echo 'unknown', PHP_EOL;
}

sections.title: Functions
sections.description: Typed parameters, defaults, named arguments, and variadics.

snippets.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function area(float $width, float $height = 1.0): float
{
    return $width * $height;
}

function total(int ...$cents): int
{
    return array_sum($cents);
}

echo area(3.5), PHP_EOL;                  // 3.5
echo area(height: 2, width: 4), PHP_EOL;  // 8
echo total(120, 75, 300), PHP_EOL;        // 495

<?php
function slugify(string $text): string
{
    return strtolower(str_replace(' ', '-', trim($text)));
}

// First-class callable syntax, PHP 8.1+
$makeSlug = slugify(...);

echo $makeSlug('Hello World'), PHP_EOL; // hello-world
echo strlen(slugify('PHP 8.3')), PHP_EOL; // 7

sections.title: Closures and Callbacks
sections.description: Anonymous functions, captured state, and arrow shorthand.

snippets.code:
<?php
$rate = 0.2;

$gross = function (float $net) use ($rate): float {
    return $net * (1 + $rate);
};

echo $gross(50.0), PHP_EOL; // 60

// Arrow functions capture outer values by value
$double = fn (int $n): int => $n * 2;
echo implode(',', array_map($double, [1, 2, 3])), PHP_EOL; // 2,4,6

<?php
$numbers = [4, 1, 7, 3];

usort($numbers, static fn (int $a, int $b): int => $a <=> $b);
echo implode(' ', $numbers), PHP_EOL; // 1 3 4 7

$prefix = 'item-';
$labels = array_map(static fn (int $n): string => $prefix . $n, $numbers);
print_r($labels);

$even = array_filter($numbers, static fn (int $n): bool => $n % 2 === 0);
print_r(array_values($even));

sections.title: Classes
sections.description: Promoted properties, readonly state, methods, and factories.

snippets.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class Invoice
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $number,
        private int $amountCents,
    ) {
    }

    public function amount(): float
    {
        return $this->amountCents / 100;
    }

    public function addItem(int $cents): static
    {
        $this->amountCents += $cents;
        return $this;
    }

    public static function fromTotal(float $total): self
    {
        return new self('INV-001', (int) round($total * 100));
    }
}

$invoice = Invoice::fromTotal(19.99)->addItem(500);
echo $invoice->amount(), PHP_EOL; // 24.99

<?php
final class Counter
{
    private static int $instances = 0;
    private int $value = 0;

    public function __construct()
    {
        self::$instances++;
    }

    public function next(): int
    {
        return ++$this->value;
    }

    public static function created(): int
    {
        return self::$instances;
    }
}

$a = new Counter();
$b = new Counter();
echo $a->next(), $b->next(), PHP_EOL; // 11
echo Counter::created(), PHP_EOL;     // 2

sections.title: Inheritance and Interfaces
sections.description: Contracts, abstract bases, and swapping implementations.

snippets.code:
<?php
interface Printable
{
    public function render(): string;
}

abstract class Document implements Printable
{
    public function __construct(protected string $title)
    {
    }

    public function render(): string
    {
        return sprintf('[%s] %s', $this->kind(), $this->title);
    }

    abstract protected function kind(): string;
}

final class Report extends Document
{
    protected function kind(): string
    {
        return 'report';
    }
}

echo (new Report('Q3 revenue'))->render(), PHP_EOL; // [report] Q3 revenue

<?php
interface Notifier
{
    public function send(string $to, string $body): bool;
}

final class MailNotifier implements Notifier
{
    public function send(string $to, string $body): bool
    {
        return str_contains($to, '@') && $body !== '';
    }
}

function dispatch(Notifier $notifier): string
{
    $sent = $notifier->send('ada@example.com', 'Build finished');
    return $sent ? 'sent' : 'rejected';
}

echo dispatch(new MailNotifier()), PHP_EOL; // sent

sections.title: Traits
sections.description: Reuse behaviour across unrelated classes and resolve collisions.

snippets.code:
<?php
trait Timestamps
{
    private ?DateTimeImmutable $changedAt = null;

    public function touch(): void
    {
        $this->changedAt = new DateTimeImmutable();
    }

    public function lastChange(): ?string
    {
        return $this->changedAt?->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');
    }
}

final class Note
{
    use Timestamps;
}

$note = new Note();
$note->touch();
echo $note->lastChange() !== null ? 'tracked' : 'untracked', PHP_EOL;

<?php
trait Loud
{
    public function speak(): string
    {
        return 'LOUD';
    }
}

trait Quiet
{
    public function speak(): string
    {
        return 'quiet';
    }
}

final class Voice
{
    use Loud, Quiet {
        Loud::speak insteadof Quiet;
        Quiet::speak as whisper;
    }
}

$voice = new Voice();
echo $voice->speak(), PHP_EOL;   // LOUD
echo $voice->whisper(), PHP_EOL; // quiet

sections.title: Namespaces and Autoload
sections.description: Namespaced classes plus a PSR-4 map that Composer can follow.

snippets.code:
<?php
namespace App\Http;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final class RequestId
{
    public function __construct(private string $value)
    {
        if ($value === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('empty request id');
        }
    }

    public static function now(): self
    {
        return new self((new DateTimeImmutable())->format('YmdHis'));
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->value;
    }
}

echo RequestId::now(), PHP_EOL;

# Regenerate the autoloader after adding a class
composer dump-autoload -o

# Confirm the class is reachable through the map
php -r 'require "vendor/autoload.php"; var_dump(class_exists("App\\Http\\RequestId"));'

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.description: Throw custom errors, catch specific types, and always clean up.

snippets.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class InsufficientFunds extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(public readonly int $shortfall)
    {
        parent::__construct("Missing {$shortfall} cents");
    }
}

function withdraw(int $balance, int $amount): int
{
    if ($amount > $balance) {
        throw new InsufficientFunds($amount - $balance);
    }
    return $balance - $amount;
}

try {
    echo withdraw(500, 800), PHP_EOL;
} catch (InsufficientFunds $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), PHP_EOL; // Missing 300 cents
} finally {
    echo 'attempt finished', PHP_EOL;
}

<?php
try {
    $data = json_decode('{"broken":', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
} catch (JsonException $error) {
    error_log('invalid payload: ' . $error->getMessage());
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    throw $error;
} finally {
    unset($data);
}

// Exceptions also surface as objects for inspection
$bad = new LogicException('rule 12 failed', 12);
echo get_class($bad), ' ', $bad->getCode(), PHP_EOL;

sections.title: PDO and Databases
sections.description: One API for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite with prepared statements.

snippets.code:
<?php
$dsn = 'mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306;dbname=shop;charset=utf8mb4';

$pdo = new PDO($dsn, 'app', 'secret', [
    PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
    PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
]);

$stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT id, name FROM products WHERE price > :min ORDER BY price');
$stmt->execute(['min' => 10]);

foreach ($stmt as $row) {
    echo $row['id'], ' ', $row['name'], PHP_EOL;
}

<?php
$pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . sys_get_temp_dir() . '/shop.sqlite', null, null, [
    PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
]);
$pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, total NUMERIC)');

$pdo->beginTransaction();
try {
    $insert = $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO orders (total) VALUES (:total)');
    $insert->execute(['total' => 249.90]);
    $orderId = (int) $pdo->lastInsertId();

    $pdo->prepare('UPDATE orders SET total = total + 1 WHERE id = :id')
        ->execute(['id' => $orderId]);

    $pdo->commit();
    echo "order {$orderId}", PHP_EOL;
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    $pdo->rollBack();
    throw $error;
}

sections.title: JSON
sections.description: Encode, decode, fail loudly on bad input, and shape custom payloads.

snippets.code:
<?php
$payload = ['id' => 12, 'tags' => ['php', 'api'], 'active' => true];

$json = json_encode($payload, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
echo $json, PHP_EOL;

$decoded = json_decode($json, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
echo $decoded['tags'][1], PHP_EOL; // api
var_dump(json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE); // true

<?php
final class Money implements JsonSerializable
{
    public function __construct(private int $cents)
    {
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return ['amount' => $this->cents / 100, 'currency' => 'EUR'];
    }
}

echo json_encode(new Money(1999), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), PHP_EOL;

// Missing keys become null when decoding to arrays
$row = json_decode('{"name":"Ada"}', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
var_dump($row['nickname'] ?? null); // NULL

sections.title: Security
sections.description: Password hashing, output escaping, and form tokens compared in constant time.

snippets.code:
<?php
$hash = password_hash('correct horse battery', PASSWORD_DEFAULT);

if (password_verify('correct horse battery', $hash)) {
    echo 'login accepted', PHP_EOL;
}

// Rehash when the default algorithm changes
if (password_needs_rehash($hash, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)) {
    $hash = password_hash('correct horse battery', PASSWORD_DEFAULT);
}

$algo = password_get_info($hash)['algoName'];
echo $algo, PHP_EOL; // default algorithm, bcrypt today

<?php
$comment = '<script>alert(1)</script>';

// Escape on output, never trust stored text
echo htmlspecialchars($comment, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8'), PHP_EOL;

$email = filter_var('ada@example.com', FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
var_dump($email); // string(15) "ada@example.com"

var_dump(filter_var('not-an-email', FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)); // false

<?php
session_start();

// One token per form, unpredictable
$token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
$_SESSION['csrf'] = $token;
echo $token, PHP_EOL;

$submitted = $_POST['csrf'] ?? '';

// hash_equals avoids timing leaks
if (!hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf'], $submitted)) {
    http_response_code(419);
    exit('stale form');
}

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: PHPUnit cases, data providers, and the commands that run them.

snippets.code:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CartTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testTotalAddsItems(): void
    {
        $cart = new Cart();
        $cart->add('tea', 350);
        $cart->add('cake', 600);

        $this->assertSame(950, $cart->totalCents());
    }

    public function testEmptyCartStartsAtZero(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(0, (new Cart())->totalCents());
    }
}

<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class SlugTest extends TestCase
{
    #[DataProvider('inputs')]
    public function testSlug(string $raw, string $expected): void
    {
        $this->assertSame($expected, slugify($raw));
    }

    public static function inputs(): iterable
    {
        yield ['Hello World', 'hello-world'];
        yield ['  PHP 8.3  ', 'php-8-3'];
    }
}

# Run the whole suite with readable names
vendor/bin/phpunit --testdox

# Narrow down to one class or method
vendor/bin/phpunit --filter CartTest
vendor/bin/phpunit --filter testEmptyCartStartsAtZero

# Terminal coverage report
vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text
